title: A/R Detail: sorting moves rows, never groups, and keeps groups open
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has open invoices, credit memos and deposits in several buckets on today's date.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu; two buckets are expanded: "31-60 days past due" and "1-30 days past due"; the other three are collapsed.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Open balance" header.
  2. Click the "Open balance" header again.
  3. Click the "Date" header.
  4. Look at which groups are expanded.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: rows re-sort inside each aging bucket, largest first; the five buckets keep their fixed order (91 or more, 61-90, 31-60, 1-30, Current).
  • Step 2: rows re-sort smallest first; the five buckets keep their fixed order (91 or more, 61-90, 31-60, 1-30, Current).
  • Step 3: rows re-sort by Date; the five buckets keep their fixed order (91 or more, 61-90, 31-60, 1-30, Current).
  • Step 4: "31-60 days past due" and "1-30 days past due" are still expanded and the others still collapsed: re-sorting never expands or collapses a group.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S2-R5: “On the grouped reports, a header click sorts the rows inside each group; the groups themselves never move (S1-R5, S1-R6).”
  • S2-R9: “Re-sorting never changes which groups are expanded or collapsed (Story 4).”
  • S4-R8: “Re-sorting and paging keep every group's expanded or collapsed state.”

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html).   • "Vendor rows pin the same way; re-sorting never collapses an open group. S4-R6, S2-R9." (caption of "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices")
  • "Buckets stay in fixed order; rows inside each bucket go by vendor name (was most overdue first). S1-R5, S2-R4, S2-R5." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name")
